skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand advanced theoretical and practical issues on the labor market.
Apply models and theories to explain results, phenomena, and trends on the labor market.
Compare and contrast characteristics of labor markets across geographic regions, industries, and ownership forms.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Behavioral Analysis of Labor Market Actors
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze the impact of economic, social, demographic, environmental, investment, international economic factors, and government policies on key variables in the labor market.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Model Building for Economic Impact Analysis
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Build and propose models to analyze and forecast the impact of microeconomic and macroeconomic factors on the behavior of actors and outcomes on the labor market.
Demonstrate initiative in learning, research, and teamwork in building and proposing economic models to explain and analyze issues and trends on the labor market.
